title: vitis angustifolia
intro: Vitis angustifolia, commonly known as Silver Buffalo Berry or Missouri Grapes, is a type of plant that belongs to the Vitaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions, including arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The therapeutic actions of Vitis angustifolia include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant, which can help soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
